item.title: PIAA WRESTLING: Hazleton Area’s Gabe Benyo advances to final
item.description: HERSHEY — Gabe Benyo wasn’t happy with the way he wrestled Thursday night. The Hazleton Area sophomore showed sometimes all you have to do is survive and advance. Benyo opened Friday with an 8-7 decision over Upper Dublin’s Dom Powell in the 114-pound quarterfinals, and secured a 4-2 win over Notre Dame Green Pond’s Cael Muller on Friday night to advance to the PIAA Class 3A final at the Giant Center in Hershey. “I wrestled really smart in the two matches,” said Benyo, who eeked out a 3-2 victor

item.description: Hazleton eased past short-handed Garnet Valley, 71-34, in the first round of the PIAA Class 6A tournament on Friday evening at Hughie McGeehan Gymnasium.

item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: March 7, 2026
item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Anthracite Model Railroad Society hosts St. Patrick’s Day open house: Noon to 4 p.m. Saturday, March 7; and Sunday, March 28. 1056 Hanover Court, Hazle Twp. Free admission; donations appreciated. Regular trains as well as Thomas the Tank Engine and friends. Hazleton Area School Retirees breakfast: 9:15 a.m. Wednesday, March 11. Tom’s Kitchen. Any recent or long-time retirees may join. Order from the menu. All-Campus Food Drive: Monday, March 9 to Friday, March 20

item.title: PIAA BASKETBALL: Comets, Fillies advance; Wreckers ousted
item.description: Crestwood overcame a slow start to build a double-digit lead, before fending off a late Holy Ghost Prep charge to edge the Firebirds, 60-58, in a PIAA Class 5A first-round boys’ basketball playoff game, Friday night, at Bensalem High School. The Comets (18-8) fell behind 7-0 early and still trailed, 11-5, after first quarter, before catching fire with an 18-5 advantage in the second to take a 23-16 halftime lead.
